description_zh: 在高速路匝道上，ego 车辆（后方移动车辆）直行时未能及时刹停，追尾了前方因交通拥堵而停住的奔驰车。选择后方车为 ego，测试其应对同车道前方静止车辆的能力。

source_snippets: the vehicle in front of him came to an abrupt stop due to slowed traffic on the freeway. The driver manually brought the Mercedes-Benz vehicle to a stop in his lane.
The vehicle behind him did not come to a stop in time and rear ended the Mercedes-Benz.
VEH 1: STOPPED, VEH 2: PROCEEDING STRAIGHT, TYPE OF COLLISION: REAR END
evidence.reason: 两车事故，后方车在移动，追尾已停住的前车。ego 选取为后方移动的车，前车作为 stopped_ahead NPC。场景可映射为典型的纵向静止前车追尾测试。
